scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && npx tsc -b apps/web/tsconfig.json --noEmit
